values.en: Criterion for a Scalar Product to Vanish

content.snl: thm-hyp(list-partial(LA.VectorSpace(K@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, V@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, $+$@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, $\cdot$@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace), Type.annotation(@k, K@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace), Type.annotation(@v, V@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace)), Logic.iff(Eq(LA.Smul($\cdot$@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, k, v), LA.Zero(V@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace)), Logic.or(Eq(k, $0$), Eq(v, LA.Zero(V@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace)))))

values.zh-CN: k·v = 0 当且仅当 k = 0 或 v = 0。
values.en: k·v = 0 if and only if k = 0 or v = 0.
